text: I'll start by looking at the workspace layout and searching for the promo code handling.
The tests reference `Discount`. Let me look at the library.
The tests point to `discounts.py` as the module to inspect, so I'll read it.

The bug is clear: a module-level `_used_codes` set records every applied code, and `is_eligible` rejects any code already in it. That's why the first order works and later ones fail until a restart clears the set. The tests require reusable discounts, so I'll remove the global tracking.

args.summary: Root cause: library/discounts.py kept a module-level `_used_codes` set. `apply_discount` added each applied code to it, and `is_eligible` rejected any code already in the set. So a reusable code like SAVE10 worked once per process, which matches the report (one more order after a restart, then it stopped again). I removed the global set and the "used" check, so a discount is only gated by its min_subtotal, as the tests expect. The full suite passes (29 tests).
